verdict.rationale: The smolagents GitHub README says the agent can use tools from any MCP server, which is the core of this story. That is the only evidence in the pack, and it is a single thin claim with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: documentation of the MCP client API or configuration (stdio/HTTP transports, how tools are loaded), a worked example of plugging in an MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
